title: Spikes make score wrap around to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
observed: After collecting a coin (score 100) and then stepping on spikes at (3,3), score becomes 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped around) and lives drop 3 -> 2.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but score never goes below 0, so score should be 0 after the spike hit (100 - 500 floored at 0).
